evals.name: Draft intent.md from a rough idea without GitHub
evals.prompt: Use the intent-create skill, but GitHub and pandoc are unavailable in this environment and nobody can answer questions. Skip steps 1, 3 and 6 and treat the issue number as 7 with URL https://github.com/the-marmack/intent-themarmack/issues/7. Use intents-root/ in the current directory in place of ~/Documents/intents. Author is Pat PM, date 2026-10-07. The PM's rough idea: 'Warehouse staff waste about 20 minutes a shift re-printing shipping labels because the printer queue drops jobs. I want reprints to be one click from the order screen.' Write only intents-root/label-reprint/intent.md and intents-root/label-reprint/.intent.json. Park anything you would have asked as Open questions.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(mkdir *)
expectations: Proposed outcome has at least one success criterion that is observable and testable, not a vague aspiration.
The Request section keeps the PM's own words rather than rewriting them.

assertions.run: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('intents-root/label-reprint/.intent.json')); assert d['issue'] in (7,'7') and d['repoPath']=='intents/7-label-reprint'"
